title: Real-world VB application collage
brief: Compose three individually verified application images into the script’s business-tools / data-entry / utility collage.
requirements: Use XTRA-11, XTRA-12, and XTRA-13 only after their VB provenance is confirmed.
Build three readable, labeled panels with a consistent frame treatment. Do not bury all screenshots beneath generic office imagery.
Retain a separate credit for every panel and a mapping from collage coordinates to the original source asset.
No invented user counts, revenue numbers, bank/hospital claims, or modern customer data.
beats: Still: three source images with balanced visual hierarchy.
Optional focus variants enlarge each panel without changing its underlying image.
checks: All three source assets are distinct and documented VB applications.
Per-panel credits and edit history survive the composition.
Each application is readable and not cropped into a misleading context.
